recipe.name: probe-experts-bf16-dual-layout
recipe.hypothesis: Cycle5 local2: the original verified BF16 KS3 caches only one weight orientation; both forward projections consume transposed views. Test dual contiguous orientations produced from the sameGS32 quantized values in the existing two batched refresh producers. Reuse the new cache across eight logical ranks and preserve original selected matmul tiles, geometry/VJP, all rates, all five original denseMLPs and shared backend. Include extra120MiB cache and producer writes in the whole-model cost. Require exact cache and output/input/router/post/geometry/weight-gradient parity, all-rank graph/probe restoration, and both first100/updates26-100 strictly faster than original incumbent before any loss/time run. No gain is assumed.
recipe.cap_rule: Stop before starting an update if current elapsed plus 1.05 times the maximum of the last four observed stage update durations plus setup reserve reaches the exact budget. Setup remains on the original timer. Report any actual overrun; strict qualification has no tolerance.
recipe.preserved: Original full PR393 MoE8 top1 router, non-KS3 blocks, CPLM, global update sizes over eight logical ranks, objective schedule, optimizer settings and FP8 formats. Full 24-update warmup restored before continuous training. Raw full validation, no canonical mask, no final window extension, no tail shipping.
recipe.hardware_change_scope: Opt-in shared nongrouped FP8 GEMM tiles across attention, dense MLP and output head; default MLP dispatch remains legacy.
recipe.evaluation_protocol: Capture live stage-two YaRN frequencies/attention scales on first reach of640/1408 windows. For terminal stage four or full-schedule completion only, restore those nonlearned buffers and use640/1408 evaluation arguments. Preserve raw learned weights, training schedule and all updates; no canonical mask, tail shipping or final window extension. Early-stage evaluation remains incompatible. All restoration/rebuild/readback/setup is inside original training timer; no strict qualification if actual elapsed exceeds902.3592145430011.
